description:
You are a retail investor who has been tracking stock purchases in a spreadsheet. You have exported your transaction history as a CSV file and now want to import it into JStock for portfolio tracking.

A CSV file containing 5 stock buy transactions is located at:
  ~/Documents/import_portfolio.csv

The file contains buy transactions for TSLA (Tesla), META (Meta Platforms), JPM (JPMorgan Chase), V (Visa), and JNJ (Johnson & Johnson).

Your task:
1. Open JStock's Portfolio Management view.
2. Import the CSV file from ~/Documents/import_portfolio.csv into the portfolio.
3. Verify that the new transactions appear in the portfolio table alongside any existing positions.

Use JStock's built-in portfolio CSV import functionality (typically found under the File or Portfolio menus). The CSV is already formatted correctly for JStock.
